# Ebaq Design

> Senior branding, logo design, identity design, and web design by Arek, a freelance brand designer based in New York City.

Ebaq Design provides brand strategy, custom logo design, brand identity systems, brand guidelines, Figma web design, website copywriting, pitch deck design, motion graphics, and Framer, Webflow, or React website development.

## Best fit

- Startups and founders that need a complete brand identity quickly.
- Service businesses, law firms, agencies, and growing companies that want senior brand and web design without a traditional agency timeline.
- Teams that need clear pricing, a focused process, and direct work with an experienced senior designer.

## Core offer

- Brand Sprint: $3,000 flat fee for the core brand identity engagement.
- Timeline: one focused week for the Brand Sprint.
- Website design or development can follow as a separate sprint or custom scope.
- Booking: https://cal.com/ebaqdesign/15min
- Contact: hello@ebaqdesign.com

- Brand strategy

- Logo animation
